description:
Brand Introduction: Rare Bunnies is a woman-owned small business dedicated to creating eco-friendly, animal-inspired backpacks for toddlers. Our mission is to keep children connected with nature through playful, sustainable products while promoting responsible consumer choices. We also donate a percentage of our profits to feed hungry children, reinforcing our commitment to positive social impact.

Product Description: Rare Bunnies backpacks are crafted from premium knitted cotton, designed specifically for toddlers. They are lightweight, easy to clean, and feature charming animal characters that kids love. The backpacks are not only functional but also safety certified, making them the perfect companion for little ones.

USP (Unique Selling Point): Our backpacks boast exclusive, patented designs that are not available anywhere else. They're designed with toddlers' small shoulders in mind, are eco-friendly, and appeal to parents looking for sustainability, safety, and the cutest animal characters for their little ones.

Payment Terms: Affiliates earn a competitive commission on every sale referred through their unique affiliate link. Payments are made monthly through PayPal or direct bank transfer, with no minimum sales threshold.

Other Information: Affiliates are provided with a range of promotional materials, including high-quality images, product descriptions, and exclusive discounts to share with their audience. We are committed to supporting our affiliates with the tools they need for success, as well as offering dedicated affiliate support and regular updates on new product launches and promotions.
name: Rare Bunnies
